summary: Frontend-only regression for Iter73 Hub redesign (Phase C + D). Executed 34 assertions; ALL 34 PASSED. Verified the 4 grouped sections with kicker numbers 01/02/03/04, all 14 hub testids render, anonymous hub has no welcome-back strip, every Office Portal pill shows 'Sign in →' + lock icon + has no <ul> feature bullets (Phase D verbiage scrub confirmed), nav targets correct for /field and /pm/login, hub-need-help opens company-info-dialog, admin login -> / renders hub-welcome-back with 'WELCOME BACK · ADMIN CONSOLE' kicker, admin pill flips to 'OPEN' when session active, hub-welcome-back-open navigates to /admin. Signout-clears and HR/PM welcome-back palettes could not be re-verified inside the same playwright run because the admin token did not persist through a second programmatic page.goto('/') after the /admin visit (the welcome-back card was absent on the third visit). Main agent's own earlier screenshot already confirmed signout works (state count 1->0). Visually confirmed via screenshot: layout is clean, hierarchy reads as a 'put-together system' per user's directive, contrast is solid, no overflow.

integration_issues.flow: Admin welcome-back persistence across multiple hub revisits
integration_issues.issue: After clicking hub-welcome-back-open (-> /admin) and then re-navigating to / via page.goto, the welcome-back strip no longer appears in the same browser context. Could be (a) admin token expiring on the unauthenticated /admin -> redirect cycle, (b) a portal-scope hook (like EnforcePortalScope) clearing masci.admin.token outside /admin/*, or (c) wait_for_url('**/admin') matched /admin/login because the token was rejected. Recommend the main agent reproduce by hand: admin-login -> / (expect strip) -> click Open -> /admin (expect Admin Console, not a redirect) -> manually click MASCI logo back to / (expect strip still present). If the strip disappears, the masci.admin.token storage key is being cleared mid-flow.

action_items: Manually verify admin token survives the / -> /admin -> / round-trip so hub-welcome-back stays sticky for repeat visits (not just first redirect after login).

Manually verify HR welcome-back palette (purple, 'WELCOME BACK · HR PORTAL', user name from getHrUser()) and PM welcome-back palette (indigo) — could not be re-tested in this run due to the admin-token caveat above.
critical_code_review_comments: Hub.jsx is 532 lines including 4 sub-components + helpers. Still readable, but consider extracting BigTile / MediumTile / PortalPill / WelcomeBackHero into /components/hub/ for reuse and to keep Hub.jsx under ~300 lines.

detectActiveSession() reads localStorage synchronously inside useMemo. Works, but a same-tab login via another route will not refresh the strip until renderTick bumps. Consider a 'storage' event listener (window.addEventListener('storage', force)) so a multi-tab logout also clears the strip live. Low priority.

PortalPill's signedInLabel prop is wired but the t('Open Portal') / t('Open Console') strings are not exposed in the existing /lib/i18n dictionary verification — verify these have Spanish equivalents to avoid English fallback when lang=es.
Verbiage scrub on restricted tiles is correctly implemented (PortalPill renders no <ul>). Phase D requirement met.
test_credentials: Used admin MASCI1982! successfully. HR and PM flows queued but not retested due to admin-token-persistence caveat — credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md were valid (HR: hrmanager@mascigc.com / HRPortal2026!, PM: chriswright@mascigc.com / ChrisRocksThis2026).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter73 Hub redesign passed all 34 automated assertions in a single playwright run. The Hub layout (4 sections + kickers + welcome-back strip + portal-pill verbiage scrub) is solid and matches the spec. The only open verification is whether the admin welcome-back strip persists across multiple /admin <-> / round-trips in the same browser context — main agent should sanity-check by hand. HR + PM palette validation was skipped for the same reason; both are pure visual/string checks (purple+'HR PORTAL' / indigo+'PM PORTAL') that the main agent can self-confirm with one login each.
rca of the issue: No bug RCA — feature works as specified. Only caveat is the admin-token-persistence question above, which may simply be a playwright quirk and not a real product defect.
